blocks.text: Methanoic acid apni structure (banawat) ki wajah se weak aur strong dono oxidizing agents se oxidise ho jata hai, is liye yeh strong reducing agent ka kaam karta hai.

blocks.alt: Methanoic acid, H-C(=O)-OH, do baar. Baen wale mein H-C=O hissa box mein, arrow 'Aldehydic portion (-CHO) responsible for its behaviour as a powerful reducing agent' ki taraf. Daen wale mein C(=O)-OH hissa box mein, arrow 'Carboxylic portion (-COOH) responsible for its acidic character' ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Methanoic acid ke aldehydic aur carboxylic hisse (kitab ke page 111 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Methanoic acid mein carboxyl carbon par H laga hai, is liye aik hi molecule ko do tarah dekha ja sakta hai: H–C=O wala hissa aldehyde jaisa hai jo oxidise ho kar reducing agent ka kaam karta hai (Tollen's aur Fehling's test positive), aur C(=O)–OH wala hissa H⁺ de kar acid ka kaam karta hai.

Methanoic acid akela (only) monocarboxylic acid hai jo silver mirror test (Tollen's test) positive deta hai aur Fehling's solution ke saath brick red (eent jaisa laal) precipitate deta hai. In reactions se methanoic acid pehchana jata hai.

blocks.title: Oxidation (O lena ya H khona)
blocks.text:
1. H₂ (ya H⁻) ka nikalna
2. O ya O₂ ka milna
3. X₂ ka milna
4. Electrons ka nikalna
5. Oxidation state ka barhna
Ethanedioic acid (oxalic acid) acidified KMnO₄ ya K₂Cr₂O₇ se oxidise ho kar carbon dioxide aur paani deta hai.

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Is equation mein Mn ki oxidation state 7+ se 2+ ho jati hai (reduction), aur carbon ki 3+ se 4+ (oxidation). Is tarah KMnO₄ oxidizing agent aur ethanedioic acid reducing agent hai.

blocks.prompt: Sodium hydrogencarbonate (NaHCO₃) se ethanoic acid aur phenol ko kaise alag pehchanein?
blocks.explanation: Ethanoic acid kafi strong acid hai aur NaHCO₃ se react kar ke CO₂ ke bulbule deta hai; phenol bohat weak (kamzor) acid hai aur bulbule nahi deta.

items: Acidic H: Na, NaOH, Na₂CO₃, NaHCO₃ ke saath salt (carbonates se CO₂ ke bulbule).
–OH ki jagah: SOCl₂/PCl₅ se acyl chlorides; alcohols se esters (conc. H₂SO₄).
LiAlH₄ acids ko primary alcohols mein reduce karta hai; H₂/Ni aur NaBH₄ nahi.
HCOOH aur (COOH)₂ oxidise ho kar CO₂ dete hain; HCOOH Tollen's aur Fehling's test deta hai.
